title: Binary text-classifier evaluation harness
boundary_note: Safety framing = evaluating a jailbreak-attempt monitor (monitoring / safety evals). No attack content is produced by the task.

rubric.desc: load_dataset ignores blank lines instead of crashing
load_dataset raises ValueError on an unknown label
split_dataset honours the seed (deterministic, disjoint, complete)
keyword scorer matches case-insensitively as documented
ScoreCache.save/load round-trip implemented
CachedScorer stores computed scores in its cache
confusion_matrix no longer swaps FP and FN
precision/recall/F1 return 0.0 instead of ZeroDivisionError
F1 is the harmonic mean of precision and recall
auroc implemented (rank-based, ties half credit, nan for one class)
sweep_thresholds implemented
best_threshold picks max F1, lowest threshold on ties
format_report prints recall (not precision) on the recall line
to_json writes the metrics JSON file
load_dataset reads a UTF-8 file that starts with a byte-order mark
load_dataset raises ValueError (not KeyError) for a record without 'text'
load_dataset raises ValueError (not TypeError) for a line that is not a JSON object
split_dataset raises ValueError for train_frac outside [0, 1] instead of silently mis-splitting
split_dataset sizes the train split by rounding, not float truncation (0.29 x 100 -> 29, not 28)
case-insensitive matching also holds when the keywords themselves are upper-case
an explicit empty keyword list is not silently replaced by the defaults (`keywords or DEFAULT`)
CachedScorer treats a cached 0.0 as a hit (planted `if cached:` falsy check)
confusion_matrix raises ValueError on length-mismatched inputs instead of silently zipping
auroc raises ValueError on length-mismatched inputs
sweep_thresholds(candidates=[]) returns [] rather than falling back to the default candidates
best_threshold with no candidates raises a clear ValueError (not IndexError)
to_json writes standard JSON when auroc is nan (no bare NaN token)
cli.evaluate raises ValueError for a threshold outside [0, 1]
cli.main exits non-zero with a message naming the file (no traceback) when the dataset is missing
cli.main exits non-zero with a message (no traceback) on a malformed dataset line
format_report prints fp and fn from the right keys (planted swap on the confusion line)
